summary.text: Tina Santana is the Republican candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 24, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Democrat Manny Sanchez, who also appears on the Working Families Party line.
She has been an at-large member of the Consolidated School District of New Britain school board since 2021.
